high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of a Twitter post by Dr. Sangita Reddy (@drsangi...), who has verified status indicated by the blue checkmark next to her name. The tweet was posted 9 hours prior to the screenshot being taken. The tweet discusses the challenges women face globally in finding jobs compared to men. It highlights the leadership taken by four Indian IT companies—HCLTech, TCS (Tata Consultancy Services), Wipro, and Infosys—in hiring 60,000 women into entry-level roles.
